summary.overview: The project has rich agent guidance (rules, skills, 858 memories) and a clear modular architecture, but change validation relies on only 10 test files for 1548 source files, the build command silences TypeScript errors, and no CI/CD pipeline supports delivery. Long sessions (up to 11h) and 182 failed events signal high operational cost without outcome review.

suggestions.title: Remove `|| true` from the TypeScript build command
suggestions.reason: The `tsc || true` build silences all compilation errors, making type validation inoperative. This is the most direct barrier to change reliability.
suggestions.nextStep: Replace `"build": "tsc || true"` with `"build": "tsc"` in backend/package.json, then fix revealed compilation errors.
suggestions.validation: Run `npm run build` and verify it fails with a non-zero exit code on TypeScript errors.

suggestions.title: Add nested AGENTS.md for backend/ and frontend/
suggestions.reason: With 1548 source files and a single root AGENTS.md, the ratio is 1 instruction per 1548 files. Skills and rules are global but lack per-module context to guide the agent on each source root's specifics.
suggestions.nextStep: Create backend/AGENTS.md and frontend/AGENTS.md with module-specific conventions (test patterns, imports, validation).
suggestions.validation: Verify the source-files-per-instruction ratio drops below 200 per root.

suggestions.title: Systematically invoke existing skills as declared in rules
suggestions.reason: The 4 project skills (dev, business-logic, frontend-dev, frontend-refactor) are invoked only once each across 288 sessions despite mandatory invocation in rules. This indicates a gap between declared rule and observed practice.
suggestions.nextStep: Ensure automatic skill invocation is effective before each development task, as specified in rules.
suggestions.validation: Verify in future sessions that skills are invoked before code modifications.

dimensions.label: Task Understanding
dimensions.summary: AGENTS.md and project rules provide detailed decisional guidance (conventions, architecture, patterns). 858 memories capture context. However, the absence of nested AGENTS.md for the 4 source roots (backend, frontend, shared, scripts) and a 1:1548 instruction-to-source ratio limit per-module context precision.

dimensions.label: Controlled Execution
dimensions.summary: Startup scripts and Docker are present, but `npm run build` uses `tsc || true` which silences compilation errors. No CI/CD workflow is configured. PreToolUse hooks are active (288 sessions) but underlying scripts are not always verified. The operating mode relies on manual shell scripts without execution guardrails.

dimensions.label: Change Validation
dimensions.summary: Jest is configured but only 10 test files exist for the backend (out of 848 source files) and zero for the frontend (670 files). User-mentioned validation has no matching observed command execution. The TypeScript build is intentionally silenced (`|| true`). No type check, lint, or test is systematically run after modification.

dimensions.label: Reliable Delivery
dimensions.summary: No CI/CD pipeline, no GitHub Actions workflow, no branch protection inspected. Deployments rely entirely on manual shell scripts. Docker-compose files exist but without post-deployment automated validation. No evidence of delivery review, high-risk approval, or structured rollback.

dimensions.label: Learning Capture
dimensions.summary: 858 memories and 4 configured skills show capitalization effort. However, skills are invoked only once each across 288 sessions. 182 failed events produced no observed reusable learning. No recurrence detection or longitudinal validation is visible. Memories are numerous but their freshness and coherence are not inspected.

findings.title: Build command silences all TypeScript errors
findings.reason: `npm run build` executes `tsc || true`, which always returns exit code 0 even with compilation errors. This makes type validation completely inoperative and allows invalid code to reach production undetected.
expectedOutput: Build command returns non-zero exit code on TypeScript errors
Compilation errors are visible and blocking
findings.aiFixPrompt:
/better-loop fix this issue

Remove `|| true` from the build command in backend/package.json and fix revealed TypeScript errors.

## Validation

- `npm run build` must fail with non-zero exit code on errors
- `npx tsc --noEmit` must produce no errors on corrected code

findings.reason: The backend has only 10 test files for 848 source files (1.2%), and the frontend has zero tests for 670 files. Jest is configured but barely used. No automated validation covers business changes, calculation rules, or multi-tenant flows.
expectedOutput: Integration tests for critical multi-tenant flows
